bottlenecks.why_exists: To align 5-second cadence SoLEXS/HEL1OS streams with 1-minute cadence GOES streams without expanding sequence length.
bottlenecks.why_matters: Washes out high-frequency sub-minute solar precursor spikes.
bottlenecks.improvement: Use a hierarchical temporal encoder or pooling layer to compress 5s features inside the model.

bottlenecks.why_exists: A single linear layer maps the flattened cross-attention output to a single logit.
bottlenecks.why_matters: Limits the classifier capacity to model non-linear combinations of multi-instrument representations.
bottlenecks.improvement: Replace the classification head with a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) containing LayerNorm and GeLU activations.

bottlenecks.why_exists: Features are fed as raw intensities without self-calibrating normalization.
bottlenecks.why_matters: Gradual sensor degradation in space shifts count scales over multi-year operations.
bottlenecks.improvement: Add a dynamic normalization layer or incorporate sat status metadata.
